statement_nl: Fix arbitrary integers n, k, l with 0 <= k <= n and 0 <= l <= n, and assume that [n choose k]_q / [n choose l]_q is a polynomial in q. Define k' := min(k, n-k) and l' := min(l, n-l). Then [n choose k]_q / [n choose l]_q = [n choose k']_q / [n choose l']_q, and also 0 <= k', 0 <= l', 2*k' <= n, and 2*l' <= n.
